Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an erroneous assumption about the necessity and relevance of a US release date despite having sufficient information to resolve the task using global release dates. In Step 1, the Planner explicitly decided to "standardize on USA release dates" and instructed the WebSurfer to find "USA release dates only," even though the initial search for "Xenoa" already provided a clear Philippine theatrical release date (August 22, 2007) and a world premiere date (August 14, 2007). This decision unnecessarily narrowed the scope of the search, leading to repeated, redundant queries for "Xenoa United States release date" that yielded no results, while the answer to the original question (which film was released earlier) could have been determined by comparing the earliest available dates (2007 for Xenoa vs. 2012/2013 for Divorce Invitation). This pattern of over-complicating a straightforward comparative question by insisting on region-specific data that was not required matches the error signature seen in Example 3.
